subject: dsa
title: Jump Game II
summary: Grow a reachable window one jump at a time. Each jump extends the window to the farthest index any cell in the current window can reach; count the jumps until it covers the end.
problem: Each value is the maximum forward jump from that index. Return the minimum number of jumps to reach the last index (assume it's always reachable).

steps.caption: Now find the fewest jumps to reach the last index. Think in layers: how far can you get with 1 jump, then 2, and so on.
With 0 jumps you're at index 0. Its value 2 means the first jump can land up to index 2 — that's the 1-jump window [0..2].
For a 2nd jump, scan that window for the best onward reach: index 1 jumps 3, landing on index 4. So 2 jumps extend coverage to index 4.
Index 4 is the last index, now covered after 2 jumps — no need to look further.
